verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents Workers as having 'no cold starts' on its global network with no servers to manage, which covers sub-second boot. For scale, the Agents runtime built on Workers/Durable Objects claims 'scaling to tens of millions of instances' and 'millions of them' that hibernate and wake on demand, and a community user describes Workers as 'very quick'. Missing for 10: a quantified boot-time figure, an explicit scale-under-load claim for plain Workers rather than Agents, and independent load-test corroboration.
